purpose: The v4 process framework: a receipt-based, append-only control plane that gates an 8-phase pipeline (init, spec, architecture, feasibility, redteam, tasks, build, ship) with SHA-256-bound evidence, owner approvals and overrides, a SQLite task ledger with fencing-token leases and a serial merge queue, and CI-side supply-chain / clean-room / commit-identity / delivery-boundary verifiers. It is generic machinery, but every hardcoded schema, string constant and gate item in this checkout is specialized to Hookemon HKMN Phase 1 (a manual one-cycle Collector-Crypt-pack-to-holder-payout loop on Robinhood Chain). It has no scheduler, no dashboard, and no live-action capability by design; those are explicitly out of scope until a fresh spec revision and owner approval (Phase 2).

Receipt JSON schema: exactly {id,at,type,phase,result,data,inputHashes}, id = r-NNNNN matching filename, at = strict ISO instant, inputHashes values = 64-hex sha256

invariants: Receipts are strictly append-only, sequence-contiguous r-00001..r-NNNNN, no symlinks, exact 6-key schema (enforced independently by receipts.mjs, check-append-only.mjs and check-delivery-boundary.mjs).

A gate result is 'authoritative' only if live re-evaluation (evaluateGate) reproduces the exact stored problems[]/gateVersion and every one of the receipt's own inputHashes still matches disk (recursively through nested receipts via isStale); otherwise state.mjs reports STALE regardless of the stored PASSED/OVERRIDDEN value.

Every OWNER action (GATE_EVIDENCE for OWNER-authority items, GATE_OVERRIDE, NOT_APPLICABLE, TASK_DEFER) requires policy/policy.json to literally contain specific fixed strings (e.g. the 'Approve your own work on behalf of the owner' never-clause, the matching askFirst clause) before it is honored at all.

A prerequisite phase must be PASSED/OVERRIDDEN and itself authoritative, and its qualifying receipt must have been authorized strictly before the receipt under evaluation, or every later phase fails closed with 'prerequisite X gate is FAILED/STALE'.

feasibility/F3 cannot pass as SYSTEM evidence while feasibility/integration-spikes.json's overallStatus != 'PASSED' or gateDisposition != 'F3 PASSED' or waivers/blockingFacts are non-empty; an artifact-authored waiver is explicitly rejected as owner authority.
Task deferral is hardcoded to taskId === 'P1-011' only (ledger.mjs taskDeferralPrestate, gates.mjs validateProjectedTaskDeferral) -- the dashboard task, and only that task.

Fee split is exact-integer: total=floor(Q*300/10000), programmable=floor(Q*10/10000), treasury=floor(Q*40/10000), process=total-programmable-treasury (never separately rounded), proven conserved across 100,000 fuzzed inputs plus 17 boundary transitions in model.mjs.

Custody-source lexer (verify-phase1-release.mjs) forbids approve/transferFrom/execute/call/delegatecall/rescue/sweep/upgrade*/set(Authorizer|Vault|Route|Executor|Admin) anywhere in the 12 custody-adjacent Solidity sources, string-literal- and comment-stripped first.
external-action-stop.json's 11 named actions must all be literally false; verify-phase1-release.mjs treats this as policy-only (no runtime interposition claimed).
stateTransitions: Gate item run status: (none) -> RUN|INHERITED|ESCALATE|NOT_APPLICABLE, recorded per-item in gates/runs/<phase>.json alongside the binding receipt id.

Gate phase result: PENDING -> PASSED|FAILED|OVERRIDDEN|EXHAUSTED_WITH_OPEN_FINDINGS, then any PASSED/OVERRIDDEN can silently become STALE the moment any bound input file's bytes change (no explicit transition -- it's a live recomputation, not a stored state).
Task: ready -> (leased, fencing token n) -> done | released-back-to-ready | deferred (terminal, P1-011 only, requires validated owner authority).
Merge queue entry: queued -> merged | retest (retest when currentIntegrationSha no longer matches the entry's recorded integration_sha).
Task completion commit can be rebound (rebindCompletionCommit) to a git-descendant commit without re-running task evidence, appending a new 'done' attempt row rather than mutating history.

Task deferral is hardcoded to a single task id (P1-011, 'dashboard') across ledger.mjs, gates.mjs and check-delivery-boundary.mjs -- reintroducing dashboard/automation work as active Phase-1-adjacent tasks would need this restriction relaxed or a fresh set of Phase-2-scoped task ids, deliberately, with the same owner sign-off ceremony as the original deferral.
